name: Sen4AgriNet: Multi-Country Agricultural Satellite Benchmark
description: Sen4AgriNet is a multi-country European benchmark dataset and machine learning pipeline developed by the National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) and Orion AI Lab in collaboration with the European Space Agency (ESA). Built to address agricultural parcel classification across heterogeneous climatic zones, the benchmark combines Sentinel-2 optical time series with European Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS) ground truth. It covers over 57,000 Sentinel-2 image patches across France and Catalonia (Spain), documenting 250,000+ agricultural parcel polygons with harmonized agricultural crop labels and vegetative indices.
